# release-please.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow release-please.</link-summary>

```text
Keeps release pull requests open with the next versions and changelogs from Conventional
Commits; merging one makes release-please tag the release. The tag then has to start the
tag-driven release (release-tag.yml), because pub.dev only accepts publications from runs that
a tag push started. Tags created with the workflow's GITHUB_TOKEN start no workflow, so:

  token-source app           (recommended) a GitHub App token; its tags start the release workflow
  token-source pat           a personal access token in the secret RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN; the same
  token-source github-token  the GITHUB_TOKEN; dispatch-workflow then starts the release workflow
                             with workflow_dispatch on each new tag (pub.dev has to allow
                             publishing from workflow_dispatch events)

Configure it with release-please-config.json and .release-please-manifest.json (manifest mode;
see examples/release-please). For a workspace: release-type dart per package,
include-component-in-tag true, tag-separator "-", so the tags are <package>-v<version>.

The caller grants contents: write, pull-requests: write, issues: write and actions: write.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  release-please:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/release-please.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config-file` | string | `release-please-config.json` | release-please configuration. |
| `manifest-file` | string | `.release-please-manifest.json` | release-please manifest with the current versions. |
| `target-branch` | string | `main` | Branch the release pull requests target; empty uses the default branch. |
| `token-source` | string | `app` | app (secrets RELEASE_APP_ID and RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY), pat (secret RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN) or github-token. |
| `dispatch-workflow` | string | empty | For token-source github-token, the file name of the release workflow to dispatch on each new tag, such as release.yml. |
| `back-merge-enabled` | boolean | `false` | After a release, open a pull request from the target branch into back-merge-branch. |
| `back-merge-branch` | string | `develop` | Branch of the back merge. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `RELEASE_APP_ID`
- `RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN`

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `releases-created` | true when release-please created at least one release. |
| `tags` | The created tags as a JSON array. |
| `paths-released` | The released package paths as a JSON array. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `actions: write`
- `contents: write`
- `issues: write`
- `pull-requests: write`
